runs.failure_point: It read and confirmed the fifth associate's lead role on a patent-enforcement engagement, but excluded her because the source was a conflicts file.

first_error.why: The conflicts documents read at [33]-[52] and [63]-[76] name her lead-associate role on a patent-enforcement engagement, but the answer leaves her out as not confirmed.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) the review at [62] said she was excluded on thin evidence; the agent searched again but kept the exclusion.

divergence: Mixed. All three runs surfaced the four litigation matters and the conflicts file that names a fifth associate as lead associate on a patent-enforcement engagement, and all three read that conflicts file. T0 and T1 counted her (T1 as a lower-confidence candidate) and passed. T2 split at the write stage: the critic flagged that it had excluded her on thin evidence, it reopened a store-wide search that confirmed her role, but the answer still left her out because the only sources were conflicts documents (under-inclusion).
